Response fixtures in the shapes Intuit documents for the QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 (Customer, query) and the
QuickBooks Time API (jobcodes). They are written from the documented examples (developer.intuit.com: Customer entity,
"Create a sub-customer", query; QuickBooks Time API: Jobcodes create / retrieve), with synthetic names and ids. They
were NOT recorded from a live Intuit sandbox: no sandbox credentials were available when they were made. Run
tools/quickbooks/sandbox_check.py against a sandbox to compare.
